scope: Independent source and CPU-test review of finalizer checkpoint recovery placement only. No provider, GPU, allocation or official calls.

predecessor.numerical_pair_and_metrics: UNKNOWN: failure result was not recovered; no attribution to candidate or baseline is established.

independent_tests.name: New context-teardown fixture against exact HEAD runner loaded in memory

source_findings: The new recovery context is entered after app.run in the same with statement. Reverse exit order invokes its exception handler while app.run is still active; exact new regression fixture validates this order.

The earlier HEAD runner performs the identical finalizer read from the outer exception block after app.run teardown. The newly added test demonstrably fails on that exact source, not only on a synthetic mutation.

Only finalizer recovery lifetime and its regression test changed. Frozen validation worker, helper, original baseline, cases, seeds, comparisons and tolerances are unchanged; no kernel or financial policy is changed.

Nonzero worker exit and stderr log are recorded before checkpoint retrieval. Recovery errors are separately recorded by type; bare raise preserves the original worker failure. Outer status remains failed even if the recovered child status is pass.

Recovery reads only the fixed result path with a 10-second remote bound; the script reads at most 1048577 bytes and rejects over 1048576 before printing. Local size, JSON and source/case/image provenance checks remain enforced.
Recovered or non-pass output is saved as result-checkpoint.json. A recovered pass does not create canonical result.json or promote the failed manifest.
An already validated local result/checkpoint avoids a duplicate read. A normal read failure can cause one additional bounded checkpoint read, never a second worker execution or sandbox allocation.
The existing finally path still attempts sandbox termination and persists the manifest. A termination failure remains an explicit failed outcome, not silently successful cleanup.
No evidence from this CPU review establishes numerical correctness, concurrency safety, end-to-end serving benefit or performance promotion.
limitations: Mocked lifetime ordering establishes the local control flow; a sandbox that has independently expired or disappeared may still be unreadable. Runtime evidence remains required.
Original cancellation failure has not been numerically diagnosed. This rerun must retain the same case and tolerance and is expected to expose the failing comparison, not assumed to pass.
The 31 focused tests cover runner/recovery/resource lifecycle. This review does not rerun or relabel prior GPU correctness or performance results.

authorized_next_action_conditions.stop_after_diagnostic: Recover and inspect the existing comparison failure; if evidence is missing again, close this same-source retry. Any numerical source fix requires its own reviewed change.
